EN: It's a Wasteland Gold Rush! Find and trade Gold Bullion so our glorious vault can thrive. But who's that knocking down the vault door? The Enclave was said to have disbanded, but now they're coming after our gold. Find out who controls the Enclave Remnants and put a stop to their raids, Overseer!
ZH: 这是废土淘金热！找到并交易金条，让我们的伟大避难所繁荣起来。但那是谁在敲打避难所大门？据说英克雷已经解散，可现在他们正冲着我们的黄金而来。监督者，去查出谁在掌控英克雷残部，并制止他们的掠夺！

EN: I've got to kill this Savage Dog before it kills me!
ZH: 我得在这只野狗杀了我之前先干掉它！

EN: The Savage Dog is moving in, ready to attack.
ZH: 野狗逼近，准备攻击。

EN: One Mole rat? It's as good as dead!
ZH: 一只鼹鼠？简直和死了一样！

EN: The Mole rat is moving in, ready to attack.
ZH: 鼹鼠逼近，准备攻击。

EN: Time to swat this Bloatfly like the insect it is!
ZH: 是时候像拍虫子一样拍死这只巨大苍蝇了！

EN: The Bloatfly is moving in, ready to attack.
ZH: 巨大苍蝇逼近，准备攻击。

EN: I'll squash this Radroach, no problem!
ZH: 我来踩扁这只辐射蟑螂，没问题！

EN: The Radroach is moving in, ready to attack.
ZH: 辐射蟑螂逼近，准备攻击。

EN: The Yao Guai is charging! It thinks I'm lunch!
ZH: 妖怪熊正向我冲过来！它把我当成了午餐！

EN: The Yao Guai is moving in, ready to attack.
ZH: 妖怪熊逼近，准备攻击。

EN: This Feral Ghoul is out of its mind! It's lunging at me!
ZH: 这只狂尸鬼一定是疯了！它正朝我扑过来！

EN: The Feral Ghoul is moving in, ready to attack.
ZH: 狂尸鬼逼近，准备攻击。

EN: The Giant Ant's antennae are quivering. It moves in for the kill!
ZH: 巨型蚂蚁的触角在颤动，正扑上来要我的命！

EN: The Giant Ant is moving in, ready to attack.
ZH: 巨型蚂蚁逼近，准备攻击。

EN: I don't see the Scavenger, but his Dog is circling, ready to bite!
ZH: 我没看到拾荒者，但他的狗正绕着我打转，准备下口！

EN: The Scavenger's Dog is moving in, ready to attack.
ZH: 拾荒者的狗在逼近，准备攻击。

EN: The Giant Worker Ant is coming my way, pincers ready!
ZH: 巨型工蚁朝我这边来了，嘴张开准备要吃了我！

EN: The Giant Worker Ant is moving in, ready to attack.
ZH: 巨型工蚁逼近，准备攻击。

EN: I don't know how I'm going to kill this Radscorpion, but I have to try!
ZH: 我不知道该怎么杀死这只辐射蝎，但无论如何我得试试！

EN: The Radscorpion is moving in, ready to attack.
ZH: 辐射蝎逼近，准备攻击。

EN: The Giant Soldier Ant sees me as a threat! It's attacking!
ZH: 巨型兵蚁认为我是个威胁，正在攻击我！

EN: The Giant Soldier Ant is moving in, ready to attack.
ZH: 巨型兵蚁逼近，准备攻击。

EN: A Fire Ant Soldier? Not like it can actually shoot fire. Time to attack!
ZH: 一只火兵蚁？它又不会真的喷火。该我出手了！

EN: The Fire Ant Soldier is moving in, ready to attack.
ZH: 火兵蚁逼近，准备攻击。

EN: The Guard Dog won't let me pass. I'll have to kill it to get by!
ZH: 这看门狗不会让我过去的。看来只有干掉它了。

EN: The Guard Dog is moving in, ready to attack.
ZH: 看门狗逼近，准备攻击。

EN: Never thought I'd be afraid of an insect, but this Fire Ant Warrior means business!
ZH: 从没想过我会怕一只虫子，但这只火蚁战士可不好对付！

EN: The Fire Ant Warrior is moving in, ready to attack.
ZH: 火蚁战士逼近，准备攻击。

EN: This Mirelurk is nothing but a crab cake on legs! Time for a snack!
ZH: 泥沼蟹不就是长了腿的蟹肉饼吗！点心时间到！

EN: The Mirelurk is moving in, ready to attack.
ZH: 泥沼蟹逼近，准备攻击。

EN: Uh oh! That Feral Ghoul Roamer is shambling toward me!
ZH: 糟糕！那只狂尸鬼漫游者正摇摇晃晃地朝我过来了！

EN: The Feral Ghoul Roamer is moving in, ready to attack.
ZH: 狂尸鬼漫游者逼近，准备攻击。

EN: A Giant Radscorpion? As if the normal ones aren't bad enough! This might be the end!
ZH: 一只巨型辐射蝎？普通的就已经够可怕了！我这回可能要完蛋了！

EN: The Giant Radscorpion is moving in, ready to attack.
ZH: 巨型辐射蝎逼近，准备攻击。

EN: I hope I can handle this Mirelurk Hunter! It's coming at me fast!
ZH: 希望我能搞定这个泥沼蟹猎杀者，它正朝我飞奔过来！

EN: The Mirelurk Hunter is moving in, ready to attack.
ZH: 泥沼蟹猎杀者逼近，准备攻击。

EN: The Vicious Dog has my scent now! He won't stop till one of us is dead!
ZH: 恶犬已经嗅出了我的味道！不是它死，就是我亡！

EN: The Vicious Dog is moving in, ready to attack.
ZH: 恶犬逼近，准备攻击。

EN: The Centaur is crawling towards me! I don't think it wants a hug!
ZH: 多脚兽正朝我爬过来！我可不觉得它想要拥抱我！

EN: The Centaur is moving in, ready to attack.
ZH: 多脚兽逼近，准备攻击。

EN: This Feral Ghoul Reaver will rip me apart if I'm not careful!
ZH: 稍不留神，狂尸鬼掠夺者就会把我撕成两半！

EN: The Feral Ghoul Reaver is moving in, ready to attack.
ZH: 狂尸鬼掠夺者逼近，准备攻击。

EN: How can I possibly survive against this Deathclaw?!
ZH: 在这只死爪面前，我怎么可能活下来？！

EN: The Deathclaw is moving in, ready to attack.
ZH: 死爪逼近，准备攻击。

EN: Enclave Deathclaws are trained to kill - this will be a fight to the death!
ZH: 英克雷死爪就是被训练来杀戮的——这将是一场你死我活的死战！

EN: The Enclave Deathclaw is moving in, ready to attack.
ZH: 英克雷死爪逼近，准备攻击。

EN: This Super Mutant sees all humans as weak - he'll try to kill me for sure!
ZH: 这个超级变种人觉得人类都弱爆了，他一定会杀了我！

EN: The Super Mutant is moving in, ready to attack.
ZH: 超级变种人逼近，准备攻击。

EN: A Super Mutant Master! This guy's no joke... but I'm ready!
ZH: 一个超级变种人大师！这家伙可不是好惹的……但我准备好了！

EN: The Super Mutant Master is moving in, ready to attack.
ZH: 超级变种人大师逼近，准备攻击。

EN: The Super Mutant Overlord is one of the strongest of its kind! I'll be lucky to survive!
ZH: 超级变种人霸王是最强的种类之一！能活下来算我走运！

EN: The Super Mutant Overlord is moving in, ready to attack.
ZH: 超级变种人霸王逼近，准备攻击。

EN: A Super Mutant Behemoth? Seriously? This is like fighting a building!
ZH: 一个巨兽？这是在逗我吗？这简直就是在和一栋楼战斗！

EN: The Super Mutant Behemoth is moving in, ready to attack.
ZH: 巨兽逼近，准备攻击。

EN: Attempting to find a way into the Broadcasting Tower.
ZH: 正试图找到进入广播塔的路。

EN: Trying to hide from the Raiders.
ZH: 试图躲开那些掠夺者。

EN: Searching the Abandoned Shack.
ZH: 正在搜查废弃小屋。

EN: Trying to pry open the Refrigerator door.
ZH: 试图撬开冰箱门。

EN: Attempting to open the Safe.
ZH: 试图打开保险箱。

EN: Trying to unlock the door to the Super Duper Mart.
ZH: 试图打开大无敌超市的大门。

EN: The Slaves are on the run, after killing their owner.
ZH: 奴隶们杀了他们的主人，正在逃跑。

EN: Attempting to liberate the Slaves.
ZH: 试图解放这些奴隶。

EN: Exploring the Gas Station.
ZH: 探索加油站。

EN: Nobody's had a meal here in a long, long time.
ZH: 已经很久很久没人在这儿吃过一顿饭了。

EN: The location looks secure, but I might be able to find a way in.
ZH: 这地方看上去挺严实的，但我也许能找到进去的方法。

EN: The people here look far from friendly. I better play my cards right.
ZH: 这儿的人看上去可不怎么友好，我得见机行事。

EN: A Synth and Super Mutant battle has trapped me in a room with a Chemistry Station.
ZH: 合成人和超级变种人的战斗把我困在了房间里，房间里就有化学工作站。

EN: A Deathclaw seems to have made the Museum its home!
ZH: 一只死爪把博物馆变成了它自己家！

EN: Most of the Plant is flooded. I'll need to swim underwater to explore it all.
ZH: 厂区大部分都被水淹了，想把这里探个遍，就得潜到水底下游过去。

EN: I've found a jammed door inside. There's an axe here I can use to break it down.
ZH: 我在里面找到一扇卡住的门。这儿有把斧子，正好可以拿来把它砸开。

EN: There's nothing on the main floors. Heading to the basement.
ZH: 主楼层什么都没有，我还是去地下室吧。

EN: The Fugitive Slave was shot in the leg. He can't get much farther.
ZH: 逃亡的奴隶腿部中枪了，他跑不远。

EN: Trying to treat the Wounded Sheriff. He's in a lot of pain.
ZH: 正在为受伤的警长处理伤口，他疼得厉害。

EN: The Ghoul is ugly, but not feral. In fact, she seems pretty friendly.
ZH: 这尸鬼长得丑，但还没狂化。其实她看上去相当友好。

EN: The Merchant is interested in bartering.
ZH: 这个商人似乎想和我做交易。

EN: The Talon Company Mercs are wary, but not hostile.
ZH: 鹰爪公司的雇佣兵满怀警惕，但没有敌意。

EN: The Hunter needs help tracking a Yao Guai.
ZH: 猎人需要我帮他找到妖怪熊。

EN: The Drunken Drifter wants to share a drink.
ZH: 喝醉的流浪汉要和我喝一杯。

EN: Trying to convince the Brotherhood Patrol that I'm harmless.
ZH: 正在设法让兄弟会巡逻队相信我毫无威胁。

EN: I'm guiding the Lost Farmer back to the nearest settlement.
ZH: 我正引导迷路的农民找到最近的定居点。

EN: He's in need of repair, but I may be able to do it.
ZH: 它需要修理，不过我也许能帮它修好。

EN: The Savage Dog bit me in the leg! Time to hobble away!
ZH: 野狗咬伤了我的腿！只能一瘸一拐地逃了！

EN: The Mole rat chewed through my boot! Time to go before I lose a foot!
ZH: 鼹鼠把我的靴子都咬穿了！得赶在丢掉一只脚之前开溜！

EN: I wasn't prepared for the Bloatfly's sting! Time to run!
ZH: 我没防住这只巨大苍蝇的蛰刺！快跑吧！

EN: The Radroach is too fast. I've had enough!
ZH: 辐射蟑螂太快了。真是受够了！

EN: I was crazy to take on this Yao Guai! Hopefully I can get away!
ZH: 我真是疯了，居然和妖怪熊杠上了。但愿我能逃脱！

EN: The Feral Ghoul is stronger than he looks! I'm out of here!
ZH: 狂尸鬼比看起来要强壮多了！我得离开这里！

EN: The Giant Ant gave me a vicious arm wound! I'm running!
ZH: 巨型蚂蚁咬伤了我的手臂！赶紧跑！

EN: The Scavenger's Dog is too tough! I can't beat it!
ZH: 拾荒者的狗太凶残了，我打不过它！

EN: The Giant Worker Ant is relentless! It's no use trying to fight!
ZH: 巨型工蚁如此冷酷无情！和它打一点用都没有！

EN: The Radscorpion nearly impaled me with its stinger! Enough of this!
ZH: 辐射蝎差点用它的螫针把我钉个对穿！我受够了！

EN: The Giant Soldier Ant wounded me! I'm bleeding... and running!
ZH: 巨型兵蚁伤了我。我在流血……正夺路而逃！

EN: The Fire Ant Soldier set my clothes on fire! I can't beat this thing!
ZH: 这火兵蚁烧了我的衣服！我打不过它！

EN: The Guard Dog really doesn't want me to pass! Time to back off!
ZH: 这只看门狗看来是真不想让我过，还是后撤吧。

EN: The Fire Ant Warrior burned me pretty badly! Time to run and recover!
ZH: 火蚁战士可把我烧惨了！得赶紧逃跑养伤。

EN: The Mirelurk nearly took my head off with its claws! I'm running!
ZH: 泥沼蟹差点用爪子把我的脑袋拧下来！我这就跑！

EN: The Feral Ghoul Roamer attacked in a frenzy! I had to run!
ZH: 狂尸鬼漫游者疯狂地袭击了我！我不得不逃！

EN: I can't possibly fight this Giant Radscorpion and live! Time to go!
ZH: 跟这只巨型辐射蝎动手，我不可能活着脱身的！赶紧跑吧！

EN: The Mirelurk Hunter was too fast for me! It was run or die!
ZH: 泥沼蟹猎杀者太快了！不跑就得死！

EN: The Vicious Dog bit me before I could react! I'm hurt and running!
ZH: 还没等我反应过来恶犬就咬了我一口！我受伤了，但只能逃跑！

EN: The Centaur is as dangerous as it is ugly! I'd better run!
ZH: 这多脚兽真是又丑又危险，我只有逃了！

EN: The Feral Ghoul Reaver was just way too strong to beat! I barely escaped alive!
ZH: 这只狂尸鬼掠夺者太强大了！我真是死里逃生！

EN: Fighting a Deathclaw? I must have been out of my mind! I've got to run!
ZH: 和死爪战斗？我一定是疯了！我得赶紧逃！

EN: The Enclave Deathclaw is trained to kill anything in its path! I have to run!
ZH: 这只英克雷死爪受过训练，会把挡它路的一切都杀掉！我得跑！

EN: No way I can defeat this Super Mutant! Time to make my escape!
ZH: 我不可能打败这个超级变种人的！赶紧找路逃吧！

EN: Turns out fighting a Super Mutant Master is a pretty stupid idea! Got to run!
ZH: 跟超级变种人大师动手，我是有多蠢！快跑！

EN: The Super Mutant Overlord is way too tough! I've got to try and escape!
ZH: 超级变种人霸王真凶悍！我必须得逃！

EN: Defeating this Super Mutant Behemoth is impossible! Escape is my only option!
ZH: 打败这只巨兽根本没门儿！逃跑是我唯一的选择！

EN: The entrance to the Broadcasting Tower is totally barricaded. There's no way in.
ZH: 广播塔的入口完全被挡住了。没法进去。

EN: The Raiders spotted me! I had to run.
ZH: 掠夺者发现了我！我不得不跑。

EN: There's nothing in the Abandoned Shack. Time to move on.
ZH: 废弃小屋里什么都没有。继续向前吧。

EN: The Refrigerator door is jammed shut. I couldn't get it open.
ZH: 冰箱门被卡住了。我打不开。

EN: I just don't have the skill to open the Safe. I'll never know what's inside...
ZH: 我打不开保险箱。永远都没法知道里面有什么了……

EN: I just can't pick the lock. I'll have to leave the Super Duper Mart behind.
ZH: 我开不了锁。只能放弃大无敌超市了。

EN: The Slaves don't trust me. They ran away.
ZH: 奴隶们不相信我。他们跑开了。

EN: The Slave Camp is too well guarded. Those poor people. I just can't help them on my own.
ZH: 奴隶营的戒备太森严了。那些可怜的人。光靠我自己无法帮助他们。

EN: The Gas Station has been picked clean. Even the fusion tanks are empty.
ZH: 加油站早被搜刮得一干二净，连聚变燃料罐都空了。

EN: I found evidence of Raiders in the Abandoned Diner. Better leave while I can.
ZH: 我在废弃餐厅里发现了掠夺者的痕迹。趁还走得掉，赶紧离开吧。

EN: A second floor window looked promising, but I couldn't reach it.
ZH: 也许二楼的窗户可以进去，但我爬不上去。

EN: I accidentally insulted one of the traders and had to run out while dodging gunfire.
ZH: 我不小心惹恼了一个商人，只好一路躲着枪子儿逃出来。

EN: I mixed the wrong chemicals and created a smoke cloud, but at least it hid my escape.
ZH: 我好像混错了化学品，升起了一团烟雾。但这至少能掩护我逃出去。

EN: I fled up the back stairs, then climbed down to safety from a window.
ZH: 我从后楼梯逃上去，再从窗户爬下来到了安全地带。

EN: I couldn't hold my breath long enough. I panicked and turned back.
ZH: 我憋气的时间不够长，有点慌张，决定原路返回。

EN: The axe is just too heavy. I can't lift it enough to get a good swing.
ZH: 这斧子也太沉了。举起它也挥不起来。

EN: A bunch of Mirelurks got the jump on me down there! I barely made it out.
ZH: 一群泥沼蟹在那下面打了我个措手不及！我勉强逃了出来。

EN: The Slave's leg is gangrenous. There's nothing I can do.
ZH: 奴隶的腿已经生了坏疽。我无能为力。
